''See also: [[Nethergate Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Nethergate serves as the primary entrance to a massive [[labyrinth]] located within [[Sacred Valley]]. Situated north of [[Yoma Mountain]], this thirty-meter-high [[stone]] door is decorated with the image of a [[Dreadgod]]. The [[Fallen Leaf School]] manages this entrance, and every ten years, its elders utilize the opening to collect treasures from labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth's upper levels. The gate is known to react to the presence of labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth's master, though it has also been observed to malfunction or fail to open on schedule. Historical records regarding the Nethergate and its contents are inconsistent and incomplete. While some believe it to be the location where [[Dreadgods]] were born, other accounts suggest it was a site used for studying [[Dreadgod]] samples. It is also considered the origin point for [[dreadbeasts]], which are lesser copies of the [[Dreadgods]]. Additionally, a [[fragment]] of an ancient [[stone tablet]] found at the base of the Nethergate has been known to possess unique, unproven properties.}}
